body:
commit c8f0062. Founder real-time / kanban priority queue: 'iterate on project burrow we need to get that ready to write the cli for emily for business and iduna pro so that parena gets transformed into idiomatic go' and 'emily for business CLI written in GO with BURROW'. Real, decisive finding that motivated this: emit_go.go's own v0 scope was 'one-expression body' only -- no real .prn function could declare a local variable at all, the single largest real gap blocking any real multi-statement logic (a CLI's own argument parsing, string building, sequential setup) from ever reaching this target. New let/do support: emitted as the exact same immediately-invoked-func-literal-boxed-through-any shape the existing if case already established, so let/do compose with if (and each other) for free -- a let nested inside an if branch always hands back a concrete, correctly-typed Go expression to whatever wraps it. Real, deliberate scope: let bindings evaluate into a CLONED local-params map, not the enclosing scope's own, so a binding never leaks outside its own let -- proven by a real test asserting the exact 'unknown identifier' error a leak would otherwise silently avoid, not just claimed. 7 new tests (single/multi-binding let, sequential-scope chaining where a later binding references an earlier one, the no-leak proof, nested-let-inside-if composition, do's own effect-then-result sequencing). go build/vet/test all clean, 73/73 total (66 prior + 7 new), zero regressions. Live-verified end to end, not just unit tests: a real two-binding let (double-it) and a real nested let-inside-if (clamp-and-double) were both compiled via a real burrow build, linked into a real, separate Go module via go build, and run -- correct output for all three real calls (double-it(5)=11, clamp-and-double(5)=10, clamp-and-double(-3)=0). Still real, honest, unstarted, named explicitly: defenum/match/loop/Result/Vec and struct construction -- a real CLI still needs match/Result (real error handling) and loop (real iteration) before 'write a CLI in this' is fully true, this closes the single biggest blocker but not the last one.

⚓ ☃
title: let/do support added to BURROW's Go emission target -- kanban cards 1199/9988
